name: Lincoln University
summary: Land-based specialist on a 120 ha campus in the town of Lincoln, 20 km from Christchurch, with three faculties from agriculture and wine to commerce.

ib.text: The Diploma must be completed with at least 24 points; English language proof applies if English is not your first language. Biology, Chemistry and Maths are recommended preparation, not required.

dates.label: Semester 1 2027 (February start): new international students apply by
Semester 2 2027 (July start): new international students apply by

programmes.name: Bachelor of Viticulture and Oenology
programmes.about: A three-year degree in the science behind grape and wine production, from vineyard soils and plant science to wine quality assessment, with work in Lincoln's own vineyards and 18 weeks of industry placements.
programmes.ib: Diploma with 24 points; Biology, Chemistry and English are highly recommended preparation.
programmes.selectionNote: The page asks only for University Entrance, which the Diploma meets at 24 points; Biology and Chemistry are recommended, not required.

flagshipSource.title: Food, Wine and Beer: Lincoln's lecturers have helped to build the New Zealand wine industry

programmes.name: Bachelor of Agricultural Science
programmes.about: A four-year science degree on farming systems, animal and plant production, soil and nutrient management and sustainability, with an Honours route in the fourth year that adds a research project.
programmes.ib: Diploma with 24 points; Biology, Chemistry, English and Maths or Statistics are highly recommended preparation.
programmes.selectionNote: The page asks only for University Entrance, which the Diploma meets at 24 points; Honours is by invitation after strong results.

flagshipSource.title: Agriculture, Horticulture and Viticulture: study areas built on practical work experience

programmes.name: Bachelor of Landscape Architecture
programmes.about: A four-year degree in landscape design, ecology and planning for urban and rural settings, taught in on-campus studios with real projects, accredited by the New Zealand Institute of Landscape Architects.
programmes.ib: Diploma with 24 points; English and Graphics or Design are highly recommended preparation.
programmes.selectionNote: The page asks only for University Entrance. It lists a February start only, so ask the admissions office when applications close for February 2028.

flagshipSource.title: Landscape Architecture: a School of Landscape Architecture and qualifications accredited by NZILA

faculties.name: Faculty of Agriculture and Life Sciences
faculties.line: Biology, Chemistry, English and Maths or Statistics are recommended for its degrees; entry is the 24-point Diploma.

faculties.name: Faculty of Agribusiness and Commerce
faculties.line: Commerce majors recommend English, with Maths or Statistics, Economics and Accounting helpful; entry is the 24-point Diploma.

faculties.name: Faculty of Environment, Society and Design
faculties.line: Landscape Architecture recommends English and Graphics or Design; entry is the 24-point Diploma.

notes: Lincoln sets its international fee by programme and holds it for the minimum time to finish; a student services fee (NZ$1,038) and insurance (NZ$999) are added for 2027.
Applications for a July 2027 start close on 1 June 2027; the deadline for February 2028 is not published yet, so ask the admissions office.
Viticulture and Oenology needs 18 weeks of practical work across a vineyard, a winery and an allied industry.
